name: latched-hyperprior
description: Latched Hyperprior Hypothesis (LHH) — a sustained vascular contraction engages the smooth-muscle latch-bridge, durably freezing a circuit as a committed hyperprior isolated from global updating; unlatches when its prediction resolves. Use when modeling durable commitments, trauma/PTSD as cemented priors, latch spirals, or the cross-substrate latch (mechanical/bioelectric/immune/sheaf).
